sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture on the back of an impressive recent run, having won four of their last five matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form, having lost their last four games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away in a match that could help them close the gap on leaders Sandbach; Town have picked up a recent draw and win but earlier lost to extend their inconsistency. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table and in strong form despite a recent loss, travel to Eccleshall (6th place, unbeaten in their last three). Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Casuals offering the more consistent recent form. Bilston Town, 6th place and in-form, visit Foley Meir in a clash of evenly matched teams around the middle of the table. New Mills, struggling with recent losses, host Market Drayton Town, who also suffer from inconsistency; this is a battle between sides desperate for momentum. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath—both clubs near the bottom fighting for points. Shawbury United, in a worrying run of five straight losses, travel to Barnton, who offer more defensive stability with recent draws mixed into their record. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, a fixture between two sides in the lower reaches; Widnes remain pointless at the foot of the table after five straight defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in another basement-battle clash, with both sides picking up rare points only sporadically.
